about: Every fix Isaac gets on Jon's Mac, and the buyer file it becomes. Rule (Jon, Oct 16): a buyer's YouCloned environment has every 'yes' and 'adapt' row from day one. Add a row in a PR the same day a fix ships. 'check' is the command that proves the fix on a buyer's computer; the setup check runs every row and the ship gate refuses a release while a yes/adapt row has no buyer_file or no check (both land later on youcloned#39).

fixes.fix: Control while the clone speaks stops the voice and opens the listen in under half a second
Control while you talk always sends your words (no 90-second cutoff)
Option interrupt stops the sound only and keeps the conversation going (VoiceMode streaming.py patch, pinned to VoiceMode 8.12.0)
"One second, still working" waits 45 seconds and never talks over a listen
Speechify sends one request at a time and retries when told to slow down
Talk wakes only the chat it points at, plus the safe restart
fixes.note: A buyer has one voice chat: Talk wakes the chat you pressed it in.

fixes.fix: Microphone permission check for each Claude version, with a warning when the current version can't hear the mic
Voice Command starts on the login whose chats hear the mic
fixes.note: Buyers have one Claude login; voice-07 covers their case.

fixes.fix: The voice chat swaps itself when it gets heavy (200k tokens or 3 hours)
fixes.note: Adds the heavy-chat trigger to the buyer's "time to change chats".

fixes.fix: One fixed Claude Code location, so mic and Desktop permissions survive updates
fixes.note: Isaac Inbox builds it on Jon's Mac first (Oct 17); ports once it passes there.

fixes.fix: Listens use listen_duration_min 8, so a short pause doesn't close your turn
Full-loop voice test and stop-time test (talk, stop, listen again, words arrive)
Usage pill always shows the last reading, dead connections dropped, readings every 5 minutes
Slack clone answers YouCloned and computer questions only from the knowledge base
fixes.note: Answers from the buyer's own knowledge base plus YouCloned's support knowledge.

fixes.fix: Nothing sends that we didn't write and okay (send gate)
fixes.buyer_file: any clone that sends email for a buyer

fixes.fix: No income claims or promises in any answer (claim gate)
fixes.buyer_file: every crew member that writes to customers

fixes.fix: Three answers per person on list replies; the third closes the thread
60-second limit on every mailbox read
fixes.buyer_file: every buyer script that reads a mailbox

fixes.fix: Chat switch: says it's time, writes the handoff, switches on a yes
Ask once to let the clone work without permission prompts
Zoom Isaac fixes: names calls, one-step walk-throughs, stops when talked over, coach role
fixes.note: Ships with that lesson, after week one.

fixes.fix: Voice late-skip fix and the never-silent "Hey" lines
Windows installer no longer counts the Microsoft Store python stub as installed
Mac installer works on Intel Macs again
Installer's skill list follows the skills split page (Global downloads, SkillKey Custom, Jon-only never shipped)
Buy-more-words link wherever the word balance shows
